item.title: Six Common Mistakes in Design Tokens Naming (4 minute read)

Other traps are mixing casing and separators, using vague modifiers like "primary" without defined scope, and renaming tokens without a phased migration and alias strategy.

item.title: ParaShells: Parallels Desktop Turns Appliance Install Into a Root Shell (9 minute read)

The root daemon exposes a world-writable Unix socket where an unsigned local process can authenticate through PrlSrv_LoginLocal. A quote in sVmParentPath injects tar's --use-compress-program option, and tar then launches an attacker script as root. Parallels released version 27.0.0 on September 1 to fix this issue.

item.title: Threat Hunting with JA4/JA4S (+ Practical KQL Queries) (5 minute read)

The post includes KQL queries to pull these values from Entra ID sign-ins and Defender network logs, so teams can learn what normal looks like and spot clients that don't match.

item.title: The £3 WiFi Extender With a Backdoor in Every Unit (13 minute read)
item.description: A £3 Z05L WiFi extender uses an MT7620 chip and a four-megabyte Winbond flash. Firmware updates verify CRC32 values only, allowing forged images, and the firewall leaves inbound services exposed on bridged networks as the config partition stores WiFi credentials in plaintext.

item.title: Scenarios for our Economic Future (12 minute read)
item.description: It is unknown yet whether AI will lead to unprecedented growth or widespread unemployment. The answer will depend on how AI affects all the tasks that make up the economy, the new tasks it creates, and how fast AI takes on this work.
